## Detailed Project Catalog

### Project 1: StreamVault (HLS Video Platform)
- **Description**: Enterprise-grade video streaming pipeline featuring automated parallel FFmpeg encoding on EC2 (c7i.2xlarge), token-gated HLS delivery using AWS CloudFront Signed Cookies, AWS Cognito authentication, and DynamoDB playback state tracking.
- **Technical Stack**: Node.js, Express, AWS EC2, AWS S3, CloudFront, Cognito, DynamoDB, FFmpeg, Docker.
- **GitHub Code**: https://github.com/pshah-lab/StreamVault
- **Key Features**: Multi-bitrate HLS segmentation, parallel multi-resolution encoding, custom signing lambdas with `SameSite=Lax` signed cookies, token-gated CDN distribution, and persistent watch-progress synchronization.

### Project 2: InsightVault (AI Document Intelligence & RAG)
- **Description**: Production-grade document intelligence and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) platform with multi-tiered vector embedding fallbacks, enterprise rate limiting, and row-level security.
- **Technical Stack**: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Supabase pgvector, LangChain, Tailwind CSS, Hugging Face, Gemini API, OpenAI.
- **GitHub Code**: https://github.com/pshah-lab/insightVault
- **Key Features**: Multi-provider embedding fallback mechanism (Hugging Face -> Gemini -> OpenAI), PDF parsing and semantic chunking, Upstash Redis sliding-window rate limiting, and tenant-isolated pgvector semantic similarity search.

### Project 3: NeuroArm Signal Flow
- **Description**: Interactive web visualization of an EEG signal processing pipeline for prosthetic arm control.
- **Technical Stack**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, D3.js, Chart.js.
- **Live Demo**: https://neuro-arm.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Code**: https://github.com/pshah-lab/NeuroArm
- **Key Features**: Visualizes raw EEG signal acquisition, filter stages, spectral analysis, ML feature extraction, classification output, and arm motor commands in real time.

### Project 4: Cloud Media Hub (AWS S3 + MongoDB)
- **Description**: Distributed cloud asset storage and media management engine with zero-buffer streaming and strict security controls.
- **Technical Stack**: Node.js, Express, AWS S3 SDK, MongoDB, Mongoose, Multer.
- **GitHub Code**: https://github.com/pshah-lab/aws-s3-mongodb-media-hub
- **Key Features**: Memory-efficient multer streaming pipelines, AWS SDK v3 upload backpressure handling, private S3 bucket streaming proxy with range headers, metadata indexing, and robust error handling.

### Project 5: Force Dark Mode (Chrome Extension MV3)
- **Description**: High-performance Manifest V3 browser extension enabling customized dark modes across all websites and local PDF/document viewers.
- **Technical Stack**: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Chrome Extensions API (MV3), PDF.js.
- **GitHub Code**: https://github.com/pshah-lab/force-dark-mode-extension
- **Key Features**: 4 customizable inversion algorithms, real-time PDF canvas recoloring, domain-specific rule matching, offline document dark reader, and sync via chrome.storage.sync.

### Project 6: Animated Website Design
- **Description**: Motion-led modern web application demonstrating fluid scroll timing, layered canvas motion, and responsive layout composition.
- **Technical Stack**: React, Tailwind CSS, GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), JavaScript.
- **Live Demo**: https://animated-design-website.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Code**: https://github.com/pshah-lab/animated-design-website
- **Key Features**: Micro-interactions, scroll-driven timelines, dark/light theme integration, high frame-rate animations.

### Project 7: Abhinandan Mountreea
- **Description**: Commercial real estate portfolio website showcasing residential projects and luxury villas.
- **Technical Stack**: React, TypeScript, GSAP, Tailwind CSS, Next.js.
- **Live Demo**: https://www.abhinandanmountreea.com/
- **Key Features**: High-definition image galleries, property layout showcases, contact inquiry forms, and cross-device performance optimization.
